say:1:1130961001:1.text: Just look at the treasure hunters—they search endlessly and come up with nothing more than injuries to themselves. I pity them.
say:1:1130961001:1.source_cn: 你看那些寻宝者，辛辛苦苦找了这么久，最后却一无所获，说...

say:2:1130961002:1.text: Archaeology is a much safer field!
say:2:1130961002:1.source_cn: 相比起来，还是考古更有保障！

say:3:1130961003:1.text: At the very least, we're rarely sent to dangerous sites.
say:3:1130961003:1.source_cn: 至少，协会派我们来的地方都确定会有历史遗迹，周围也没有...

say:4:1130961004:1.text: As long as we remain diligent in our studies, there's always something to new discover!
say:4:1130961004:1.source_cn: 只要我们认真研究，总不至于半点收获也没有！
